description: SHA-256 of each @mcp.tool handler's exact source (decorators through last line, dedented) inside register_mcp_surface, captured before wave 1y0h1 edited server_impl.py. Wave 1ypxw updates only wf_review_wave and wf_review_event for approved receipt-currency docstrings; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 1z8tz updates only docs_search and code_search for the restored tag vocabulary (memory) and the rechunk remedy in their docstrings. Wave 1zlu1 adds wf_close_change and updates only wf_create_wave for its new optional parent parameter. Wave 1zyc3 updates only wf_review_event for its new optional attested_by parameter. Wave 1zyc5 updates only seed_get, wf_get_prompt and wf_help for the renamed planning help goal and prompt examples in their docstrings. Wave 1zyb4 (change 1zxnx) updates only wf_review_event for the council-delivery signoff key example in its docstring. Wave 203pu updates only wf_graph_report for the call_edge_counts docstring. Wave 2087n updates only memory_propose for explicit source-event selection; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 20b3a (change 20b34) updates only wf_upgrade for root-qualified accounting-gap recovery guidance; all other captured hashes and handler-name pins are retained. Wave 20t73 updates only wf_upgrade and memory_backfill to ordinary index publication and on-demand memory guidance; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 215sy updates only code_ask, code_search and docs_search for incomplete-index question answering; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 21j63 (change 21kk5) updates only wf_review_event for the council intent_fit evidence field in its docstring; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 22upa (change 22ubf) updates only wf_review_event for the security_unsettled disposition and the operator close in its docstring; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 230k8 (change 230k6) updates only wf_review_event (impact and containment factors, reconsideration) and wf_close_change (review-authority gate) for their docstrings; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 23lxd (change 23myn) updates only code_ask, code_search, memory_propose, wf_close_change, wf_get_change, wf_get_prompt, wf_list_plans, wf_new_bug, wf_new_change, wf_new_documentation, wf_new_enhancement, wf_new_feature, wf_new_maintenance, wf_new_operations, wf_new_refactor, wf_new_task, wf_new_tech_debt and wf_upgrade for the spec and behavior contract terminology in their docstrings, and seed_get for the renamed planning seed in its docstring example; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 23p89 (change 23q1g) updates only wf_review_wave and wf_review_event for the delivery approval membership rule, the delivery approval refusal and the scope advisory in their docstrings; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 23q0t (change 23q0s) adds wf_cleanup_work; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 23q0t (change 23phc, delivery repair) updates only wf_audit for its data sub-objects, which now name work_root, in its docstring; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 23p9u (change 23p9t) updates only wf_close_wave for the advisory record_extras_present in its docstring; all other captured hashes are retained. Wave 23td0 (23tcy) updates the docstrings and profile-aware description decoration of memory_propose, wf_close_change, wf_close_wave, wf_get_change, wf_get_prompt, wf_list_plans, wf_new_bug, wf_new_change, wf_new_documentation, wf_new_enhancement, wf_new_feature, wf_new_maintenance, wf_new_operations, wf_new_refactor, wf_new_task, wf_new_tech_debt. Handler bodies and other hashes are unchanged. Wave 23xo7 updates wf_open_gate for close-time workspace ownership and wf_current_wave, wf_list_waves and wf_pause_wave for the reviewed-delivery hint.
